title: WaferLLM: Large Language Model Inference at Wafer Scale
technique: wafer-scale LLM parallelism (PLMR model), MeshGEMM/MeshGEMV, shift-based KV cache management

optimized_metrics.evidence: Since LLMs generate many tokens, especially in the test-time scaling scenario, such as the OpenAI-o1/o3 and DeepSeek-R1, inference is constrained by GEMV latency, making it inherently memory-bandwidth-bound.
optimized_metrics.locator: §1 (txt line 60-64); metric TPR defined in §7 'maximum per-request throughput'

optimized_metrics.evidence: running complete LLM inference on a single chip, minimizing costly off-chip communication and maximizing on-chip memory bandwidth utilization

headline_claim.text: For full LLM inference, WaferLLM achieves 10-20x speedups over A100 GPU clusters running SGLang and vLLM.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: we define Throughput per Request (TPR) as a key metric. TPR is derived from the more widely used Time per Output Token (TPOT), with TPR = 1/TPOT.
metric_definitions.notes: Per-request token rate (tokens/s), batch-1 style; same idea as tokens/s/user.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: the end-to-end throughput is calculated as the total number of tokens generated during the decode phase divided by the total time spent in the prefill and decode phases
metric_definitions.notes: Output tokens only; includes prefill time in the denominator.

load_regime: batch=1 single-request; fixed input/output lengths (e.g. 2048/2048 combos)
tradeoff_acknowledged: none; notes that more GPUs raise concurrent-query throughput but not per-request speed
hardware: Cerebras WSE-2 (+ simulator for scaling); baselines 8-16x A100 with SGLang, vLLM
extractor_notes: TPR = 1/TPOT is the batch-1 per-user token rate; included as TPS_USER per request. Single-stream latency emphasis (GEMV, decode).
load_class_quote: "To evaluate the maximum per-request throughput performance of LLM inference systems on different hardware, we define Throughput per Request (TPR) as a key metric." (§7); batch=1, fixed input/output lengths
